messages:
elaine: FYI ran the weekly docs crawler, found several images 403'ing in the handbook + runtime examples. most are small diagrams and one large screenshot in /handbook/setup. linking the scan: https://internal-scanner/reports/6155556789. can someone pick this up? easy PRs but want to coordinate owners before mass edits. :wave:

rohit: I can pickup the handbook ones. quick question: do we rehost to assets.redwood-inference.com or use the new S3-backed shortlink host? last time we changed shortlink host we had to update support tickets mapping.

elaine: prefer assets.redwood-inference.com for static assets. keep shortlinks intact unless they are explicit /r/ redirects and unmaintained. i'll flag any suspicious /r/* entries in the PR body.

jamie: if you want a tiny script to enumerate the offending files:

    # list markdown files referencing old-cdn or broken hosts\    rg "https?://(old-cdn|cdn\.examplecorp)" docs handbook -n --hidden

    # quick copy to new host (dry-run)
    python tools/rehost_image.py --dry-run --target=https://assets.redwood-inference.com <list.txt>

  i'll review the PRs for style and alt text. also please run image-optimizer on the svgs.

ci-bot: scan result: 11 hits across 9 files. severity: medium. recommended: rehost for durability + add alt text. https://internal-scanner/reports/6155556789

rohit: opened branch docs/rehost/6155556789 and pushed three small commits for handbook/setup images. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4310 (draft). added label docs:rehost and request-review @jamie.

elaine: quick reminder: don't replace maintained redirects. before changing any /r/xxxx links, check shortlink-mapping in infra/team. ping @infra if unclear. last time a maintained redirect was replaced, our support dashboard lost context for ~45 tickets.

infra: confirming — we have a shortlink map at infra/shortlinks.yaml. if a file references /r/, please open an infra chat and we'll confirm. also note some redirects are intentionally ephemeral for A/B experiments.

jamie: review started. small nit: a couple images missing alt text and one screenshot is >1.2MB. inline the smaller icons? or svg-optimise and rehost.

rohit: will svgo svg files and compress screenshot to <500kb before update. updating PR shortly. tagging handbook owners in the PR description for visibility.

elaine: thanks. leaving a thread ping here so people who don't watch PRs see it. will close when all merged. :white_check_mark:
